description: This Java source file defines an abstract class for validating hyphenated identifiers with a specific check digit logic, used for identifiers with a hyphen followed by a character (A-J) or digit. It provides methods to generate and validate such identifiers, ensuring they meet specific rules about allowed characters and check digit calculation.

classes.name: BaseHyphenatedIdentifierValidator
classes.description: An abstract class implementing common validation logic for hyphenated identifiers with a check digit, which subclasses must implement to specify the check digit calculation.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a valid identifier by appending a check digit character to the undecorated identifier.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the format and check digit of a given identifier, ensuring it contains a hyphen followed by a valid check digit character or number.

methods.name: checkAllowedIdentifier
methods.description: Checks whether the undecorated identifier contains only allowed characters and is not null or empty.

methods.name: convertCheckDigitToChar
methods.description: Converts an integer check digit (0-9) into its corresponding character (A-J).
